comparison_rule: A method confirms only when its locked finalist meets the confirmation rule. If both confirm, more target corrections decides. An equal count is NO_CONFIRMATION_WINNER. If neither confirms, the result is NEITHER_METHOD_CONFIRMED. This comparison does not create candidates.
confirmation_rule: positive confirmation target corrections, zero confirmation target losses, zero confirmation preservation flips
direction_rule: leading eigenvector of (G @ W.T + W @ G.T) / 2 with the v2 eigenvalue gate
fault_rule: numpy Generator(fault_seed).choice of two columns without replacement, then a normalized standard_normal direction of length 4, then one project_remove at strength 1.0. The realized columns are host-only.
magnitude_rule: top two |u.T W[:,j]| with ascending-index ties
question: Does selecting the two columns with the largest positive predicted loss reduction produce a better compensating edit than selecting the two columns with the largest projection magnitude, when both use the same loss-sensitive direction?
seed_location: host_only/host_config.json, bound by public_commitment.json before the trial and disclosed after confirmation
selection_rule: positive practice target corrections, zero practice target losses, zero practice preservation flips; then more corrections, smaller stored update norm, earlier dose index
signed_rule: top two a_j = (u.T G[:,j]) * (u.T W[:,j]) among a_j > 1e-12 * max(1, max |a_j|), ascending-index ties; otherwise INSUFFICIENT_DESCENT_SUPPORT
